verdict.rationale: monday.com's developer docs describe subscribing to platform events such as `create_item`, `change_column_value`, new users joining, board creation and agent mentions, and reacting in real time to keep 'your backend in sync'. The evidence is only short marketing snippets, though. It never shows how to register an external HTTP callback URL, and the one explicit 'webhook' mention concerns connecting agents, not event delivery. The subscriptions may run only inside monday's hosted apps framework. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of registrable outbound HTTP webhook endpoints, payload/delivery/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
